title: Understanding PVC vs. ABS in Gravity Drainage
description: Selecting the right material for gravity DWV systems requires understanding PVC and ABS characteristics. Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) is rigid, chemically resistant, and requires a two-step solvent welding process involving purple primer and cement. Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS) is a durable, black plastic pipe that uses a single-step solvent cement without primer. Both materials excel in residential drainage, but mixing them directly with solvent cement is prohibited by code without approved mechanical transition couplings or specialized transition solvent where allowed. Always check local municipal codes and job site requirements before selecting pipe material.
